items.overview: The sequel series to "Kinnikuman ii sei".     A new threat appears to defeat the Legends, known only as the 'Time Chojin'. These mysterious villains travel through time, in their quest to eradicate the Justice Chojin. If their plan succeeds, they will erase the New Generation from history and usher in a new era of evil domination over the humans.     The New Generation must travel through time to stop the Time Chojin.    In the process, they earn the distrust of the Legends. The ensuing conflict triggers the start of the 'Ultimate Chojin Tag Tournament', which will pit Legends against New Generation, and Justice Chojin vs Evil Chojin. The winners will determine the future of the planet as we know it and reign supreme over Earth.

"In this realm mythological creatures roam, descendant of the nine heavens they call home." 

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. items.overview:
Lady Elizabeth has her engagement annulled at a party by the crown prince, whose heart has moved on to another young noblewoman. She is then imprisoned in the dungeon over unjust accusations, and learns she has been betrayed by the country to which she has devoted everything...

At the peak of her frustration, Elizabeth finally decides to defect, with a grimoire holding hidden and formidable powers in hand!! She begins her new life and trade with the help of Viscount Lucas from the neighbouring country. With a fierce desire for revenge against her home country in her heart.

items.title: Mahoromi - Jikuu Kenchiku Genshitan
aliases: マホロミ 時空建築幻視譚
Mahoromi: A Visionary Tale of Space-Time Architecture
items.overview:
Niwa, a college student of architecture, is moving into his deceased grandfather's house. He didn't know the man very well, but the house is conveniently close to school, and his grandfather was actually the architect who designed it. There's something unsettling about the house, though, and while he's wandering around, Niwa finds a mysterious old photograph of some girl who isn't his grandmother.  
  
Later, he goes along with his friend Akira to take drawings of another old house that's going to be demolished. As he meanders through this old house, he has a somewhat supernatural and startling experience. Are these feelings and occurrences a result of the souls of the buildings themselves, as Akira suggests? Or is there some even deeper mystery to Niwa's uncanny experiences?

items.title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
items.overview:
The huge, poker-faced Oosaki-san is intimidating at first glance, but she's actually gentle and shy. Joining her at work is the new part-timer, the petite and friendly 147cm Komori-san.
Despite their appearances and personalities being total opposites, they find themselves drawn to one another without even realizing...!
The awkward crybaby Oosaki-san is a carnivore of love, whereas the oblivious easy-going Komori-san is a total herbivore.

What lies in store on the path of love for this mismatched pair with a 50 centimeter height gap...?

items.overview: Shun was the star of his middle school's soccer team, until an injury forced him to give up on his dream. Now in high school, he’s adrift, with no real interests or passions… until he meets his oddball upperclassman Naoki. She ropes him into joining her unofficial “Hyper-Epic Heading Home Club”, a club with only one member dedicated to turning every walk home into an adventure. As Shun follows Naoki through her flights of fancy in search of elaborate detours, secret treasures, and anything else that catches her attention, can the Heading Home Club bring color back to his drab everyday life? items.title: Skip to Loafer
aliases: スキップとローファー
items.overview:
Iwakura Mitsumi always had big dreams, of leaving her small town, advancing to a top tier university, and then contributing to the country before retiring back to her home town. So focused is she on her goal that she is oblivious to all the other ways she comes up short, much to the chagrin and concern of her friends and family. Can a naive country girl make it in Tokyo?
___
**Note:**
* Nominated for the 2020 Manga Taisho Award, came in third behind the winner Blue Period and second place, Spy x Family.
* Winner of the 47th Kodansha Manga Award in the Best General Manga category in 2023.

aliases: Collected Fragments of a Layered City
items.overview:
A vast, towering layered city, built by humanity after gaining access to advanced technology. As people gaze upon the city while its construction advances, or go about their lives as residents within it, humans and the things created by humans each continue to layer their own ways of living.

This is a record of "life", capturing various eras of a world moving toward its end.

items.title: Ring ni Kakero
aliases: Put It All in the Ring
items.overview:
Friendship. Effort. Victory!

The story centers around the life of a young boxer named Ryuji Takane and his sister Kiku, who is his coach. Ryuji and his sister both inherited their father's talent for boxing with Ryuji inheriting his strength and techniques while Kiku picked up his talent for analysis and strategy. In the past, their father was a famous boxer. Ryuji and Kiku went away from home to train and become famous in order to help their lonely mother. On the way to stardom, they have to defeat the strongest challengers all over the world.

The work that solidified the themes of Weekly Shonen Jump. Those themes being Friendship, Effort, and Victory!
